states: Vite dev server on this tree (origin/main 41cea2ffab plus the change) against a private PULSE_MOCK_MODE backend (8-node estate) built with a local-only go build -overlay (never committed). The overlay stamps TrueNAS disk sdb with physicalDisk.temperature 61 and collection.temperature unavailable 'host agent stopped reporting' (the shape a TrueNAS disk merged with a silent host agent row reaches), pins sdd to a current 58, gives pve3 SATA disk /dev/nvme2 the same retained state (51) and marks pve3's sensor payload legacySensorsFormat; /api/resources and the websocket rows carried those states

Before control in the same session (the four runtime files swapped to origin/main under the running Vite, then restored and compared byte for byte): sdb Temp cell plain 61.0°C sorting first in hottest-first, drawer Temperature row 61°C in the amber warning tone, TrueNAS summary 'SATA, Passed, 16.0 TB, 61°C', History with no smart_temp points showing '-', and no outdated sensor setup notice for pve3

After, Temp sort: descending sdd 58, sdf 47, nvme0n1 46, sda 46, sde 42, nvme1n1 41, sdc 39, then sdb last; ascending sdc 39 ... sdd 58, then sdb last (a retained reading sorts as no reading)

After, sdb row drawer (Platform details > Show TrueNAS): Health Temperature row '61°C (last known)' in text-muted with the reason as its title; the collapsed TrueNAS summary reads 'SATA, Passed, 16.0 TB' with no temperature

After, sdb drawer History tab: with seeded points the legend shows the stored 53°C and the line 'Disk reading: Last known reading, not current: host agent stopped reporting.'; with the smart_temp series emptied by a Playwright route the legend reads 'Disk 61°C last known' (data-history-last-known=smart_temp, no 'current') with the same line; current disk sdd with no points reads 'Disk 58°C current'

Re-run the node setup script to upgrade it.' notice shows at both widths (hidden on main); /proxmox Overview loads no physical disks so the notice cannot show there on main or after (pre-existing, chipped separately)
